planets.name: HAT-P-4 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-4 with a 3.06-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: HAT-P-4 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-4. Its orbit and size follow Torres et al. 2008's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname TORRES_ET_AL__2008): disc_year 2007, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.05652301, pl_radj 1.274, pl_bmassj 0.671

quotes.title: HAT-P-4b
quotes.card: HAT-P-4b is a confirmed extrasolar planet orbiting the star HAT-P-4 over 1000 light years away in Boötes constellation.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered by transit on October 2, 2007, which looks for slight dimming of stars caused by planets that passed in front of them.
